## Checklist (Definition of Done)
- [ ] Code compiles without errors or warnings
- [ ] Linting / formatting enforced (ESLint / Prettier / dotnet format)
- [ ] Unit tests added / updated
- [ ] Frontend component tests added if applicable
- [ ] Acceptance criteria in the linked issue are fully met
- [ ] Permissions / ownership enforced where applicable
- [ ] PR linked to the GitHub Issue
- [ ] Reviewer assigned (secondary owner)
- [ ] Screenshots / GIFs for UI changes included
- [ ] CI checks pass (build, lint, test)
